The video begins with a shot of the K-pop band BTS seated in a row against a backdrop featuring the text "LOVE YOURSELF" along with the band's name. They are dressed in various styles of light-colored shirts and dark pants and generally clapping and smiling. A text box with "BTS, K-Pop Band" is overlaid on the bottom left. The video then transitions to show a young man with curly hair wearing a pink hoodie, which reads "LOVE YOURSELF" and he is seated and holding a small notebook. The setting is a studio with blue curtains in the background. He speaks in English, stating that he has his questions in his "handy-dandy" notebook. He holds up the notebook, which has pictures of BTS on the cover. The clip cuts back and forth between the BTS members reacting and the interviewer asking questions in English with Spanish subtitles. BTS is laughing at the interviewer using the notebook with their images. The interviewer declares he is ARMY (BTS fandom name) and says it will be hard to read his questions because there are photos of them everywhere, before congratulating them on their album. The interviewer then quotes RM from when they met at the AMAs stating “el amor es la clave para la integracion de toda la sociedad” (love is the key for the integration of all of society). He asks what kind of message they are trying to send with this new era of Love Yourself. RM proceeds to answer explaining “Basically, love is complex… There are some sides that make us really feel bad… There could be tears, there could be sadness… So this time we want to focus on some of the parts of love we want to run away from… so the name is Tear… and the main title is going to be the name Fake Love… Fake Love, so we want to say that if you are untrue to yourself, the love won’t last… and the love could be between one person and another person, and it could be between you and yourself.” The scene remains consistent, with the focus primarily on the faces and gestures of those speaking.

The scene features a panel interview with the members of BTS, a South Korean boy band, and an interviewer. The seven members of BTS are seated in chairs against a backdrop promoting their album "Love Yourself: Tear." They are dressed in casual yet stylish attire, including shirts in blue, yellow, black, and white. The interviewer, a young man with curly hair wearing a pink hoodie with "Love Yourself" printed on it, holds a book in his hand and addresses the group. His questions, translated in Spanish subtitles as "¿Sentiste la presión lanzando 'Singularity'? Es la primera canción de este álbum. / De algún modo estableciste las expectativas de todo. ¿No fue un poco de presión para ti?" (Did you feel the pressure releasing "Singularity"? It’s the first song of this album. / You somehow set the expectations for everything. Wasn’t it a little pressure for you?). The members respond with expressions of agreement and humor; one member, V, responds in English with "Of course," followed by a burst of laughter from the leader, RM. V later adds that dancing alone is very difficult. Jimin points out that this is the first time he is seeing V work so hard at dancing. The interviewer commends V for doing well, and the group applauds in response. The interviewer then changes topics, stating in Spanish, "Por supuesto, hablemos del significado de sus canciones. / Por supuesto, lo mencionaste antes." (Of course, let’s talk about the meaning of your songs. / Of course, you mentioned it before.). The camera angle shifts between the whole group and individual shots of the interviewer, enhancing the interaction between them. The setting is a professional interview setup with dark curtains in the background.

The video features an interviewer in a pink hoodie with the words "LOVE YOURSELF" on it, asking a question to BTS, a Korean boy group. The question, subtitled in Spanish, asks if they feel a moral obligation to create songs with social consciousness, given their international success. As he asks, the camera alternates between him and the seven members of BTS, seated together. Their expressions are serious and thoughtful. Su-ga responds that he believes anyone with influence should be trying to send a positive message, and the more people emit positive messages and energy, the more positive and better the world will be for everyone. After Su-ga's answer, the interviewer responds by calling the statement beautiful and says he loved it. He then says he is excited for the BBMAs. All of this takes place against a backdrop with repeated "BTS LOVE YOURSELF Tear" logo.

The video segment begins with a shot of a fair-skinned man wearing a pink hoodie that says "LOVE YOURSELF" on the left chest, seated in a black chair, gesturing with a piece of paper. He is facing two men. He is speaking in English, and the video has subtitles in Spanish that state "Estamos muy emocionados por tenerlos aquí para que presenten Fake Love" (We are very excited to have you here to present Fake Love). The scene transitions to a shot of seven men seated, who make up the popular musical band BTS. They are positioned against a backdrop that features the words "LOVE YOURSELF" and "BTS". The Spanish subtitles change, now showing a question: "MC: ¿Qué es lo que les emociona más que ARMY viva durante esta nueva era de BTS?" (MC: What excites you the most that ARMY is experiencing during this new era of BTS?). As the video continues, the man in the pink hoodie asks this question. A member of the band replies in Korean. The Spanish subtitle reads "JH: Los nuevos visuales" (JH: The new visuals). Some of the BTS members then name aspects that excite them, such as the dances, songs, makeup, and glasses. RM then says the member's hair is always changing. RM mentions that Jungkook (BTS member in a yellow t-shirt), now has a bigger body shape compared to when he was a child. The MC says "Hemos pasado por una locura de viaje. Si piensan en el 2013 cuando comenzaron, y ven lo que se acerca para ustedes." (You have gone through a crazy journey. If you think about 2013 when you started, and you see what is coming for you.). RM says his body shape and hair. The MC says "Muchos cambios. Ve tu cara hahaha. Todo eso." (Many changes. Look at your face hahaha. All that.). In the background, the scene shows dark curtains. There are occasional close-ups of the band members and the man in the pink hoodie, showing their reactions.

The video begins with a wide shot of seven men from the band BTS sitting in chairs on a stage facing an interviewer off-screen. A text banner appears in the upper right-hand corner showing the name of the YouTube channel, "@yoongified93." The BTS members are dressed in semi-formal attire with different colored shirts. The interviewer asks the band members in English, “What would you say? Would you have any advice for yourself because I’m sure you would have had no idea that things were going to go this way for you?” A text overlay appears on the screen with the translation, “MC: ¿Qué se dirían? ¿Tendrían algún consejo para ustedes mismos? Porque estoy seguro de que no tenían idea de que las cosas serían así para ustedes.” (MC: What would you say? Do you have any advice for yourselves? Because I am sure you had no idea that things would be like this for you.) There is a quick transition to a close-up shot of the interviewer, a curly-haired man wearing a pink "Love Yourself" hoodie, looking at one of the band members. Then, the camera cuts back to the wide shot of BTS on stage, where one band member jokingly says, “Please study English,” which is translated by a text overlay on the screen that reads, “JK: Por favor estudia inglés.” (“JK: Please study English.”) Another band member agrees, saying, “Sí, por favor estudia inglés.” (“Yes, please study English.”) This is followed by a quick close-up of the interviewer and then another wide shot of BTS on the stage. Different members of BTS take turns giving advice to their past selves, which are translated in Spanish subtitles. The members show a range of emotions from amusement and laughter to seriousness. The scene is against a backdrop of repeating "BTS" logos and "Love Yourself" text. Towards the end of the segment, band member Suga tells himself in Spanish, “Por favor estudia inglés.” (“Please study English.”)

The video segment showcases BTS in an interview setting. Seven members of the group are seated side by side on chairs, dressed in casual attire, as an MC, wearing a pink hoodie with the phrase "Love Yourself" printed on it, addresses them. The MC gestures with his hands as he speaks about BTS and their fans' efforts to give back to charities, particularly UNICEF. The background features "Love Yourself" tour posters. The members listen attentively, with RM, in a light blue shirt, responding to the MC's question with gestures. Text captions in Spanish appear at the bottom of the screen. These captions include MC: "La última vez hablamos de UNICEF, ser recíprocos, pero no solo son ustedes quienes son recíprocos. Sus fans, ARMY, han sido inspirados por ustedes para reciprocar. He visto proyectos hechos por fans, en los que la gente dan miles de dólares a la caridad, en particular a UNICEF. ¿Por qué piensan que es tan importante reciprocar?", and RM: "Algunas veces en verdad sentimos que recibimos demasiado amor, incluso más del que merecemos. Para alguien que recibe tanto amor, es importante ser recíprocos. Porque, sabes, el amor no es como un recurso. Podemos dar y dar y dar por todo el mundo.". (English translation: MC: "The last time we talked about UNICEF, being reciprocal, but you are not the only ones who are reciprocal. Your fans, ARMY, have been inspired by you to reciprocate. I have seen projects made by fans, in which people give thousands of dollars to charity, in particular to UNICEF. Why do you think it is so important to reciprocate?", and RM: "Sometimes we truly feel that we receive too much love, even more than we deserve. For someone who receives so much love, it is important to be reciprocal. Because, you know, love is not like a resource. We can give and give and give all over the world.")

The video opens with a medium shot of a fair-skinned individual with curly brown hair, wearing a light pink hoodie with "LOVE YOURSELF" printed on it, sitting in a chair. Subtitles in Spanish read "MC: Eso es hermoso. La vez pasada nos reunimos y les pregunté cuál era el siguiente paso" (MC: That is beautiful. Last time we met, I asked them what was the next step). He is facing another person, with only their back visible. The scene transitions to a wider shot of seven individuals, likely BTS members, seated together in front of a backdrop with "BTS LOVE YOURSELF Tour" printed on it. The Spanish subtitles continue: "MC: para BTS, y Suga dijo que su meta era presentarse en los BBMAs. Y vean en dónde estamos ahora." (MC: for BTS, and Suga said that his goal was to perform at the BBMAs. And look where we are now). The man in the pink hoodie is visible again, gesturing emphatically with his hands as he speaks to the person facing away from the camera. The scene cuts back to BTS, and Jimin playfully extends his leg, showing the red sole of his shoe. The subtitles read: "JM: Paso. MC/RM: Siguiente paso." (JM: Step. MC/RM: Next step). There are laughter and smiles from the BTS members. The man in the pink hoodie returns to the screen, asking the question again. The camera goes back to BTS. Suga says, "¿Grammy?". The man in the pink hoodie points. The subtitles read: "JH: Grammy. MC: Eso dice ahora, la próxima vez estaremos como "entonces, los Grammys"" (JH: Grammy. MC: He says that now, next time we will be like "then, the Grammys"). RM says "Vamos a ver. Los Grammys son otro mundo, creo que él lo dijo la primera vez." (Let's see. The Grammys are another world, I think he said it the first time.) The background is a dark blue curtain, suggesting a studio or interview setting.

The video shows the popular music band BTS in an interview setting with a male interviewer in a pink hoodie. The band members are seated, mostly wearing pastel button-down shirts and dark pants; a dark blue wall displaying “Love Yourself Tour” with the band’s name is behind them. RM playfully suggests that Suga was the first to call the Grammys “another world,” with the interviewer then asking what the band wants to be remembered for in twenty years. After speaking in Korean, Jimin explains he would like them to be remembered as people who always tried to show their sincerity. The interviewer follows up by praising and congratulating the band for their new album and J-Hope for “Hope World.” As the clip continues, an interviewer gives the band members a box of custom donuts with a BTS logo on the center donuts, some saying “Congratulations BTS from Liam”, with members smiling at the gift while thanking them. The clip ends with the interviewer saying his hair looks good, getting a nod from RM, and the rest of the group laugh; and ending with a screen showing a reminder to “Subscribe and Watch More J-14 Videos!”
